name: Wildcard mounts preserve the chosen mount's cast time and cancellation (#4600)
contract: Wildcard Mount 91944 and Wildcard Flying Mount 93539 must use a normal mount cast. Green Riding Nether Ray 39798 has a 1500 ms cast (SpellCastTimes 16) and native local-mount variants 498697 on the ground or 498695 with 300 riding in Outland. A normal 39798 cast is the control. Wildcard selection must start that same cast, remain unmounted during it, honor a native cancel request, and mount only after completion. The flying fixture also knows ground-only Brewfest Kodo 49322, which must not be selected for the flying action. The Outland coordinates come from the world game_tele HellfirePeninsula row. This observes native casts and mounted auras, not a rendered cast bar. Setting riding to 300 teaches the whole mount skill-line repertoire in this fixture. After riding and spell setup, native unlearn actions remove the other wrappers: the ground actor retains only 39798, and the flying actor retains 39798 plus ground-only 49322. This makes both random selections deterministic without seeding a cast or mounted aura.

steps.label: An ordinary mount retains its native cast time
Wildcard Mount starts an ordinary mount cast
The mount is not applied before the cast finishes
A completed Wildcard cast applies the ground mount
Flying selection excludes the known ground-only mount
The chosen flying mount applies after casting
